book.name: Luke
book.title: Luke ka Te Pabe'e Jesus, Te Naa Tooa'a-witu, Numu oo Tuukwena

content: Soo Te Pabe'e ka mana tooe hano'yoona tooe nanesootuhidyina tunemamakwuse soo sumu'yoo oo nakatzimodu meeoo oo netamma, “Ne Pabe'e, ne nanesootuhi tunedyooe, ka John umu tu nakatzimodu tunedyooe-kwa'nesoo.”

Soo Te Pabe'e yise meeoo mu netamma, “Ka nanesootuhina mee unneyi, Ne Naa ne pa'anakwatu, u tubetse besa'yoo. U no'oko numme-kooba pooha katudu. Numme no'oko numu yaa teepu-koobatu ume mu nakabetseana soogwa'e, ka u-baatu-kwa'nesoo.
Nonotsa tu tabe mea-kwi tukapu gi ne namatuugekwuna.
Ka ne tuma'emukwana soomu'wana numme puu oo soomu'wa ka mu numu suda numme matugu. Ne matzino kaaheno ne mayugwe. O'no numme besa-kwitoo tsebooe petugakwu.”

Soo Te Pabe'e yise umu pumme nakatzimodu meeoo netamma, “Tamme sakwa ooosapa nanetsagwayidyi. Mu numu nanetsagwayina 'yoo manepunne. How sakwa puu tamme ka togabeno ka tu pua'a nobe-witoo mease ka oo yadooe petugase mee unnena,
‘E pua'a mana kwinga'atu pudu petuhoose, nu gi hemma oo maka-wa'ne manepunne. U sakwa pihoo tukaba nano'hona e hemepunne?’
Sumuna soo u pua'a gi u tutzakwonakwu-wa'ne'yoo ka mooasoo habena, umu oo doodooamu tuwa mooasoo bokwa, oosoo yise gi yotsese u maka-wa'ne'yoo.
Pana saa'a pumme u nenoyukwe oosoo yotsese ka natzakwona tzakwuna, yise u makakwu. Tamme nanesootuhidyina o'nosoo soo Te Naa te sootuhise ka natzakwona tzakwonase, te makakwu.

Nu yise meeoo mu netammakwu, tutubenguse u nageakwu, oo watena u oo mayukwu, tutokangese u natutzakwonakukwu. Soo tooe haga tooe tutubengadu oo nageakwu, soo tuwatedu oo mayukwu, soo tutokangedu oo natsakwonakukwu.
U puu ka u tooa'a ka pakwe nekwa'e gi togogwa oo gea-wa'ne'yoo.
Tooe tamme gi totoge'yoopana puu te dooamu besa matugu, soo Te Naa yise tamme besa matugukwu Tu Besa Pooha-matu-ma te sootuhikwu.”

Soo Te Pabe'e ka tsoapayidu nana gi besa yadooadu nanesootuhikuse, yise ka oo namabesakuhoose soo tsoapayidu nana besa manese, yadooawunu. Mu numu ka Te Pabe'e ka nana namabesakuse oo poonnena oo nesookwuga'e.
Susumudu mu numu ka oo nakana yise meeoo nana'unakwe, “Esoo nana Jesus ka tsoapa nematzagakwunihoo. Oosoo ka umuoosoo pooha-ma oo mu yugwewunu.”
Susumudu yise ka oo manena poonnena gi oo soo'oedyukuna unusoo oo pooha manikwuna nepoonne.

Soo Te Pabe'e ka mooasoo pumme mu sooyugwena sopedakwadoona, mee mu netamma, “Mu numu ka pumme moohedu gi nakabetseana nanano nananepetukana, soo mu moohedu gi mu numu moohe-wa'ne tabu'a, mu numu yise kadoo'oo sukwe namayugwekwu.

Mu gi toge unakwe mu ka, ‘Numu poohadu,’ mee e netammana. Soo numu poohadu gi hownnekoo nanesootuhina ka tsoapa numu-nagakoo nematzagakwuni-wa'ne'yoo. Soo suta'yoo gi ka tsoapa numu-nagakoo nanematzagakwunina petzape, umu tsoapa ka oo tutummatzina.
Mu Jew numu moohedu puu ka mu tsoapa numu-nagakoo nanesootuhikuna mu nematzagakwuna'e. Mu puu gi numu poohadu mee mu ne'a. Mu sakwa gi nuka meeoo soobedyapana.
Ka Te Naa Besa Pooha-toohakwi nu nanesootuhina mu tsoapa nematzagakwuni, mu sakwa meno'o oo sopedakwadoo soo Te Naa no'oko numu sootuha'e.
Nu ka mu susutakoo moohedu ooonakwasoo unu pooha-gana nuga pooha ooosapa oo matzoekute. Soo natzooedu nana puu ka tu hemma besa takonena gi hee oo matzooekute,
pana ka numu tzakunase o'no yise oo hemma hanekwu.
Yooosoo nu ka sutakoo yugwese o'no nu mu numu magwetzoikwu ka suta-makoo.
Soo tsoapa ka numu-nagakoo natayase, kumma'akoosoo puma tu kaduookwunu wate, pana gi tuma'yu, yise ka gi tuma'yuna meeoo unakwe, ‘Nu punowsoo kodyukakwu.’
Ka numu punaga'yoo tumeahoopu mayuse, oosoo numuna sumuna gisoo ka Te Naa Besa Pooha-ma nasoonatza'ena.
O'no yise soo tsoapa natakwatsukwu (7) kukumma'akoosoo tsotsoapa pumme ooonakwa unu susutakoosoo bise ka punaga'yoona tumeapu-nagatoosoo kodyukakwu. Soo nana yise unusoo suda namanatzayakwu.”
Sumu'yoo mogo'ne oonow numu-naga wunudu ka oo nakase meeoo oo netamma, “U pea sakwa nasootuhi ka u dooa'adoose yise ka u petzekuse tuwazoo.”
Pana soo Te Pabe'e meeoo oo netamma, “Oo mu numu ka Te Naa unnepu nakana, ka oo oedyukuna umu unu nasootuhikwu,” mee.

Ka mu numu ewasoo manemena soo Te Pabe'e yise meeoo mu netamma, “Mu suta'yoo numu gi e naka'oedyukudu ka nanasookwugi besa e manena poonnese e naka'oedyukukwu suu'mu, mee mu tusooyugwe. Ka o'nosoo Te Naa yadooawabe, Jonah mee naneadu
ka mu wakwawa'a numu Te Naa unnepu tuukwena mu oo naka'oedyukute. Nu yise yow Mu Pabe'e mu-baa petuse pana mu gi e naka'oedyukute.

O'nosoo soo mogo'ne mana mu taba mea-nakwatu numu nehane katudu, puu kwinga'a kemma ka mu Jew numu-kooba katudu Solomon mee naneadu oo tunetammana nakakwuse, ‘Ka unu oo sopedakwadoo,’ mee neyugwena. Tooe nu ka Solomon ooonakwa unu tusopedakwadoopana mu gi e nakabetse'a.
Ka numu paba nanehaneno'o mu wakwawa'a ka Jonah naka'oedyukupu sakwa mu nemadabue ka mu meno'o gi nuka naka'oedyukudu, tooe nu ka Jonah ooonnakwa pooha-gakooapa.

Soo besa e unnepu tukootabuakunoo kootabua-kwa'ne. Tamme puu ka oo kootabuakuse paa'a hee-kooba oo wuna. O'no soo tooe haga tooe petudu no'oko hemma mesoo poonne. Gi tamme puu kawona-tooha oo watzetugu.
Soo te pooe puu tukootabuakunoo-kwa'ne'yoo. Tamme ka besow poonnena suu'mu tamme besa'yookwu, pana tamme ka sutakoo poonnena suta tusooyugwekwu.
Tamme ka besow nakasopedakwatoo,
tamme besa'yookwu.”
Ka Te Pabe'e yadooawunu, sumu'yoo nana nasootuhidu Pharisee mee nananedu-nagatu punno'o oo tuka tuungu. Oosoo yise oo-no tuka kaduhoo.
Mu Jew numu tu mi mooe bakomase tuka, ka oo tumatuguna. Soo Jew nana yise meeoo soonamme, “How manena soo Jesus tuka gisoo tu mi bakomana?”

Te Pabe'e yise mee ka nana netamma, “Mu Jew numu tumatuguna, puu besa ka mu tookoomatsu'a, pana soo mu soonammena togesoo totsa'a, ka numu mooa-gana mu suta'yoo. Ka tseda-kumitu suu'mu matsuana soo oetu togesoo totsa'a.
Te Naa namekoo mu mi noko mu soonammena matabuepu. Te Naa yise namekoo gi mu totsana sookwa'e.
U ka mu tutuha manedu numu makana u besa'yoo.

Mu Pharisee nananesootuhidu tooe gi haanoko hemma hanepana mu ka Te Naa tosamakayakwe. Mu besa manakwe ka oo tosamakana. Mu gi ka Te Naa besa unnepu nakabetsea ka Te Naa unu soobedyanaka kukumma'akoosoo numu besa matuguna, mee na'unnena.

Mu Pharisee nananesootuhidu mu ka tu na'ewa tuka besa-kwi mooe aatahooyakwe, ka tu nananesootuha'e mu tuwazoo ooosoo. Mu kukumma'akoosoo numu, ‘Oosoo besa nanesootuhidu,’ mee mumme mu netammana soobedya. Mu tuma'emukwana saa'a mu-maatoosoo kodyukwu.
Mu suda manakwe ka kukumma'akoosoo numu ne'emukwana ka Te Naa besa po oemota mu moohena.”
Sumu'yoo ka nanesootuhibu tunedyooedu-matu ka Te Pabe'e mee netamma, “U suda numme-witu waha tuwazoo.”

Soo Te Pabe'e yise mee oo netamma, “Mu nanesootuhibu numu tunedyooedu punno'o mu tuma'emukwadu mu-matoosoo kodyukwu. Mu ka mu kukumma'akoosoo numu unu namanedu tumayohope nage tuungu pana mu gi hownnekoo ooka mu mayoho tummatzi-wa'ne'yoo.
Mu puu ka o'nosoo Te Naa yadooawabe besa nanomatuoo'na, ka umu mu nanamooatupu tugoena besa matabuena.
Mu tookwa ka mu nanamooatupu tugoena toge'yookute, o'no mu ka mu nanomatuoonana besa matabu'e.
Soo Te Naa gi hemma watzekudu mee unakwe, ‘Tooe nu ka umu e yadooawabe umu-matoo tayase sapa umu mu kusegana mu ko'ehookwu.’
Mu oe naneyukwe ka no'oko Te Naa yadooawabe goese.
Mu nanesootuhibu tunedyooedu ka puusoo gi ka Te Naa nakabetseana gi hownnekoo ka Te Naa nakabetsea-kwitu mu numu tunedyooe-wa'ne'yoo.”
Ka Te Pabe'e meahookwuse mu Pharisee unu oo sutakuna oo tooe nemasutana,
o'no oosoo suda unnise umu ookow oe neyugwekwu mee too'e sokwamana.
